purpose: Falsify whether source-trained two-specialist causal memory improves unannounced A to B to A rule recovery over original NativeEpisodeExperience, independently trained causal full/discount/dual controls and fully fitted conventional Beta/Hedge controls.

mechanism.source: Genuine observed CKAD39 public actions, two-stage transition and terminal outcomes only; no private phase enters learner.
mechanism.original_native: One continuous NativeEpisodeExperience(repair=True), unchanged; warm 48 then begin_stream, all observed source episodes.
mechanism.causal_controls: Existing CKAD42 NativeInterventionRelations full, short discount .93 and dual, trained on every genuine observed source event, unchanged.
mechanism.candidate: Two persistent NativeInterventionRelations experts A/B. Initially A trains observed episodes. A 12-event prequential active Brier alarm above 0.21 after warm allocates empty B; from the next event train active expert only, freeze inactive expert. No replay into new B, no checkpoint reset.
mechanism.switching: Once B has 16 genuine observed episodes, compare last 12 PREQUENTIALLY scored A/B source-only short-readout Brier values. Switch when alternative has at least .035 smaller mean and 8 events minimum dwell. Both experts score before seeing current outcomes. Never use evaluator phase, future outcome or hidden world.
mechanism.readout: Active expert short-readout transition and terminal (terminal sees already revealed next_state); both read-only. Preserve learned A and B weights and source-ID custody.
ablations: never-switch B reference after B initialized

evaluation: Separate early B, late B, early A return, late A return and pooled late B plus late A return two-stage Brier; compare on precisely same real synthetic observations/actions. Source purity, cold exactness, extra compute and allocated expert counts. Private A/B labels evaluator-only.

frozen_thresholds.decision: If any threshold fails DEV_NO_GO. Otherwise DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC. On any DEV_NO_GO stop CKAD43; no same-seed retuning, held first-use, full regression, merge or science claim.

qualification: Commit preregistration FIRST. Then fixture-only unit tests with protected seed guards and exact original native and experimental expert checkpoint/read identity, same exact source SHA two-OS DEV screen. No scientific first use or accepted runtime changes. This is reused synthetic family development, not unfamiliar-world transfer or proof of intelligence.
resources: 2 DEV seeds x 2 worlds, ~900 genuine synthetic episodes; multi-expert update and checkpoint work must be measured and cannot be characterized as matched compute or efficiency.
